findings.summary: Page opens with English index names and a dark screen, which feels scary to someone looking for safe saving. This is a matter of tone and taste, and it doesn't block use.
The 2% inflation assumption only shows after opening a box. The reader did open it, so the button works. This is a wish for more visibility, not a blocker.
The small grey caveat text under the result numbers is hard to read even when enlarged. It is secondary text, not the main figure.
The cost bar uses similar colors and tiny numbers, and the large tax segment (15,364) has no plain explanation. The reader can't properly understand a main figure.
The −122 ₪ minus sign made the reader pause, but they understood it is just the gap between two options. A minor stumble.
Nothing says the 7% return isn't guaranteed or that the fund can lose value. This could lead to a wrong decision.
Key terms (קרן מחקה, נאמן, דמי משמרת) are not explained where they appear. A novice can't understand the options being compared.
